measured.known: Tools, open: the boards draw it as a bare label at rest and a padded box when open, which moves the label 10px left as the menu opens. The build keeps the label where it rests and draws the box out into the gaps, so the open box sits 10px right of the board's and nothing moves.

deviations.why: Tools, open: the boards draw it as a bare label at rest and a padded box when open, which moves the label 10px left as the menu opens. The build keeps the label where it rests and draws the box out into the gaps, so the open box sits 10px right of the board's and nothing moves.
The menu hangs off the Tools box, which sits 10px right of the board's open box (see Tools, open); its width, radius, padding, rows and its offset from the trigger match.

limitations: Headless Chrome component fixture; not WKWebView, native window drag or the live app.
